note.es: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Mineral para vacuno sin sal (16 % de fosforo y 16 % de calcio), envase de 20 kg; el precio por envase se pasa a tonelada (x50). Serie mensual en dolares canadienses. Cambio de unidad hecho por Dehesa Index con aritmetica exacta, sin estimar nada.
note.en: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Salt-free mineral for cattle (16 % phosphorus and 16 % calcium), 20 kg bag; the price per bag is converted to a tonne (x50). Monthly series in Canadian dollars. Unit conversion done by Dehesa Index with exact arithmetic; nothing is estimated.
note.fr: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Minéral sans sel pour bovins (16 % de phosphore et 16 % de calcium), sac de 20 kg ; le prix par sac est converti en tonne (x50). Série mensuelle en dollars canadiens. Changement d'unité effectué par Dehesa Index en arithmétique exacte, sans rien estimer.
note.it: Alberta Agriculture and Irrigation, Alberta Farm Input Prices (Open Government Licence - Alberta): Minerale senza sale per bovini (16 % di fosforo e 16 % di calcio), sacco da 20 kg; il prezzo per sacco è convertito in tonnellata (x50). Serie mensile in dollari canadesi. Cambio di unità eseguito da Dehesa Index con aritmetica esatta, senza stimare nulla.
